prompt: Add Select same fill to the palette. With one layer selected, it selects the layers whose fill is the same colour as that one's, the original included, so I can change them together, even when they sit inside groups. It's offered only when exactly one layer with a fill is selected.
reference: Searches only the top-level frame that holds the selected layer, at any depth, or, for a layer outside every frame, the other layers outside frames.

naive.summary: Searches the whole document, so matching layers on every other screen are selected too.
